summary: Keep full-content repository reads out of the pool authority lock, bound S3 and SFTP network stalls, and use a manifest-and-size read for prune, protection, catalog rebuild and published-backup settlement. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Catalog rebuild now checks artifact presence and size instead of digests; restore and test restore still hash every artifact.

api.reason: Internal Core repository I/O only; no route, payload, permission or result change between Controller and Core.

roadmap.reason: Corrects the current destination safety and liveness gate.

state.reason: No new durable record. Core's repository manifests, markers and catalog are unchanged; a fresh Controller adopts the master's authenticated inventory as before.

verification.method: Focused tests failed red against the prior sources through go test -overlay (artifact downloaded twice on S3 publication; Membership blocked for more than 2 s during S3 abort; SFTP stalled server hung past a 2-minute test deadline; SFTP and filesystem rebuild refused a same-size content change; S3 client had no bounded HTTP client) and pass after the fix. Focused agent backup/repository tests, vmhost backup tests and focused -race on the new tests passed.
verification.limits: Fake S3 and in-process SFTP/SSH fixtures only; no real provider, lab or large-repository timing run. A mid-transfer stall where the SSH server still answers keepalives is bounded only by the caller context. Forge CI remains open.
